annotationRationale: The carry formula forces the new digit sum to differ from 1275 by a multiple of 9. This congruence selects the candidate, and an explicit numeral proves attainability.
sourceMethod: Followed the official trailing-nines method and its construction, using the resulting congruence to check the choices.

review.mathCheck: Exactly k trailing nines give \(S(n+1)=1275-9k\), hence remainder 6 modulo 9. Only 1239 qualifies. The stated numeral has digit sum \(1238+36=1274\) and yields 1239 after incrementing. An all-nines numeral is impossible here because 1274 is not divisible by 9.
